notes: Mountain Giant - EVERY other card in hand, not just minions
Molten Giant - damage TAKEN, so armor does not count and healing gives it back
Sea Giant - every other minion on the battlefield, both sides
Clockwork Giant - cards in the OPPONENT's hand
Dread Corsair - one less per Attack of your weapon
Crackle - Overload is printed and applied automatically
Lightning Storm - a separate 2-3 roll for each enemy minion
Mortal Coil - a Divine Shield that absorbs the hit is a SURVIVAL, so no draw
Slam - the inverse of Mortal Coil
Divine Spirit - adds current health once; it does not keep multiplying
Vol'jin - swaps CURRENT health and clears damage on both sides
Scarlet Purifier - granted deathrattles count too
Fel Cannon - YOUR turn only; -mech is a negative race
Gahz'rilla - doubles on each instance of damage it takes
